PLAN:
- App: swipe left to delete, right to keep photos/videos. Local, privacy-focused. StoreKit 2 + AdMob. 5-10k LOC, buildable in ~1 day.
- Video strategy: DON'T script beforehand. Set up OBS (screen + face cam), hit record, build the app, stop recording. Edit after — intro/outro recorded after you know what the video is.
- Ned is NOT camera shy. Blocker was 'not knowing what to film' — resolved by 'just film the build'
- Ned can build the app in one day. The skill gap is video, not code.

CONTEXT: Post-demo-day content-first pivot. App is the prop for content, not the other way around. 3/10 excitement — enough to act on given zero baseline.

STATUS: Planned but not started as of March 11. Ned was going to build it but got stuck.
